configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Default day-to-day preset: Debug build, tests on, default compiler.

configurePresets.name: gcc
configurePresets.description: Half of the GCC/Clang MS-extension-divergence check from Doc/linux_roadmap/16-testing-and-validation.md — run locally, no CI.

configurePresets.name: clang
configurePresets.description: Other half of the GCC/Clang divergence check. GCC and Clang tolerate different MSVC extensions, which is exactly what this pair is meant to surface.

configurePresets.name: gcc-fetched
configurePresets.description: Forces every alienfx_require_package() dependency down the FetchContent branch, so that path is exercised even though this machine has every dependency available as a system package.

configurePresets.name: system-only
configurePresets.description: Simulates a distro packaging sandbox: no downloads allowed. A missing system dependency must be a loud configure failure, never a silent network fetch.
